exclusion_detail: The lead (complex C2, {BuPhSn[2-OH-C6H4(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO](MeOH)}2) is a dinuclear organotin(IV) complex made by a one-pot microwave reaction of hydrazide, keto acid and butylphenyltin dichloride; an organometallic complex, not a small organic molecule.

lead.label: C2
lead.why: Abstract: 'Complex C2 demonstrated the optimal inhibitory effect on HepG2 cells, with an IC50 value of 0.82 uM'.

notes: Organometallic (tin) complexes throughout the paper; no organic-only compound is the product.
